title: Affine quadric: selective Lean 4 formalization
description: Selective Lean 4 companion formalization for Hamiltonian Desingularization, Collision Asymptotics, and Exact Critical Modes for Cohomogeneity-One IIB Solitons on the Affine Quadric. The repository documents exact mathematical hypotheses and external boundaries in FORMALIZATION_SCOPE.md. Lean 4.24.0 and all dependencies are pinned. Software version 0.1.0 was released on 5 November 2026 at 12:36:49 UTC (tag v0.1.0, commit e3efcf4e2a46da9b84e6928935d43eb6d9ec854a) and archived at https://zenodo.org/records/23979530. Its version-specific DOI is 10.5281/zenodo.23979530; the software concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23979529 identifies the collection of software versions. The companion preprint was published on 5 November 2026 at https://zenodo.org/records/23956688, with version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23956688 and concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23956687. The software supplements the preprint (isSupplementTo). The software is licensed under MIT; the preprint is separately licensed under CC BY 4.0. Exact hypotheses and external mathematical boundaries remain those documented in FORMALIZATION_SCOPE.md.
